description:
The device protection status. This property is read-only.

TIP: Microsoft Defender Antivirus health of one Windows device, as Intune last received it. Returns malwareProtectionEnabled, realTimeProtectionEnabled, networkInspectionSystemEnabled, tamperProtectionEnabled, isVirtualMachine, quickScanOverdue, fullScanOverdue, fullScanRequired, rebootRequired, signatureUpdateOverdue, signatureVersion, antiMalwareVersion, engineVersion, lastQuickScanDateTime, lastFullScanDateTime, lastQuickScanSignatureVersion, lastReportedDateTime, deviceState (clean, fullScanPending, rebootPending, manualStepsPending, offlineScanPending, critical) and productStatus. Pass $expand=detectedMalwareState for the threats currently detected on the device. Supports $select and $expand.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

name: get-windows-protection-state
